verdict.rationale: Neon documents managing projects programmatically at very large scale through its API, and neon.ts declares one per-branch policy (TTLs, compute sizing, protected status) for every branch. The MCP server also offers a "Run SQL Transaction" tool for multi-statement execution. However, no dedicated bulk endpoint or batch action for acting on many projects or branches in one operation is documented, so most of the story rests on implied scripting over per-item API calls. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch API or CLI/MCP operation across many projects or branches, documented limits and behavior of such operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Platforms can manage tens of thousands (in some cases, millions) of projects programmatically through the Neon API. Project creation, configuration, and cleanup are fully automated
It declares which Neon services exist on your project and how each branch is configured
